about: The falsifier: every place's key carried two digests of the whole lock, every line it stands on and every line it owns, so a line that landed anywhere moved every place, and every act folded the tree whole, twice: once to check the batch and once after it landed. Each fold also did again, for its own place, what the tree does once: the lock's standing, the lines each key signed, the second head, the own locks the places speak, and every reading of the tree the place then threw away.
